Welltec is strengthening the Operations team in Esbjerg, Denmark, and actively recruiting for Field Engineer Trainee/Field Engineer positions. We have several openings and we are looking for both experienced and trainee levels.

A world-class company

Welltec® is an international oilfield service company and a leading specialist partner to the energy industry.

Our values are to be Pioneering, Visionary, Dedicated, and Agile.

We develop and manufacture precision-controlled technologies which provide the most unique and advanced Completion and Intervention solutions, which assist our clients in maximizing recovery from their assets.

We always look to the future, utilizing our intelligence, imagination and expertise to create new opportunities. We have won several industry awards for innovative thinking. We are enjoying constant growth worldwide through the wide adoption of our cutting-edge solutions.

Our policy is to hire locally and work globally. We therefore recruit where we are active and train our employees to operate our state-of-the-art technologies to provide services to our high-profile clients in the region.

The global dimension offers a range of opportunities for those who are motivated by a challenging and multicultural environment where employees come with very different backgrounds but with a common wish to collaborate and succeed.

The department

Welltec is strengthening the Operations team in Esbjerg, Denmark, and actively recruiting for Field Engineer Trainee/Field Engineer positions. We have several openings and we are looking for both experienced and trainee levels.

The position

You will join a team of approximately 8 field engineers and you will be reporting to the Senior Service Delivery Manager.

As a Field Engineer at Welltec, you will receive exceptional training that will guarantee a successful career in diverse roles and responsibilities in the energy industry.

Key responsibilities

• Prepare and execute complex onshore and offshore operations across the European Continent.

• Perform job load-out and rig up/down at wellsite, both land and offshore environments.

• Follow detailed processes and procedures to maintain an industry leading level of service quality.

• Uphold a high level of customer service at all times.

• Undertake technical, safety, and shop/office responsibilities as assigned by the Operations Manager and Serive Delivery Manager

• Maintain equipment and facilities in an orderly and workable condition.

The candidate

The ideal candidate has the following profile:

• Experience from E-line operations and/or logging tools is plus

• Leads by example in promoting and maintaining a safe workplace and holding others in the field accountable to this high standard

• Detailed problem solver with a keen interest in all types of engineering and technology

• Working, understanding of electrical, mechanical, and hydraulic engineering principals and be able to grasp new ideas quickly

• Must be teachable, coachable, willing to push boundaries and challenge conventional thinking

• Be an ambassador for Welltec and Welltec technology when performing jobs on site – This includes building good relationships and promoting Welltec services

• Be a highly motivated individual who approach challenges with a positive ‘can-do-attitude’ and is willing to work under pressure and in varying remote conditions.

• Be IT confident and proficient within the Microsoft Office suite and be capable of learning bespoke software quickly.

• Be able to complete the standard requirements to travel offshore and abroad, e.g. offshore medical and survival.

• EU passport is a must due to specific local requirements

What we offer

Working with Welltec® means challenges and personal development in a demanding work environment. It is exciting and rewarding, and it is a varied place to work. Welltec® is an equal opportunity employer. We offer good career opportunities for the right candidate. Also, Welltec® has a competitive compensation package.

The process

If you are interested in the position submit your resume and cover letter online via the link below.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply soon if you believe you fit the role.

As a Technical Manager in Welltec’s Well Completions Services segment, you will be part of the Global Operations department. You will become part of a team that is recognized as the go-to technical experts for Welltec’s Well Completions Services.

Here, you will find yourself working with a global scope in one of Welltec’s fast-growing business segments with a fantastic opportunity to become an expert in our world-class tools, be part of an exciting growth journey and make a big impact on our operations.

The position

As a our new Technical Manager, your work will center around ensuring smooth, fail-safe, and high quality delivery of Welltec’s Well Completion Services and tools. The primary focus of your position will be on providing technical advice and assistance to our diverse clients, operational- and commercial teams, mostly in the eastern hemisphere.

In this position, you will have a great opportunity to learn and develop - and help others to learn and develop. Your training during onboarding will be hands-on and rewarding. You will be asked to learn a lot to become an independent technical expert but in return you will be given responsibility and support to make your impact early, develop your skillset and start becoming an important part of our business.

You will be working from our base in Esbjerg in Denmark but will occasionally travel to other bases around the world.

Key responsibilities

•    Provide technical advise and guidance to our operational staff and to clients (IOC’s, NOC’s, service companies, global drilling contractors, etc.) during technical discussions, job-planning, ongoing jobs and post-jobs

•    Conduct follow-up meetings or reviews with clients after invesitgations and incidents

•    Be the technical expert in sales processes in collaboration with our commercial teams

•    Review, monitor and safety- & quality-assure job plans, instructions, procedures and other documents at our various bases to ensure compliance with high safety and quality standards

•    Teach our staff about our tools, services and Well Completions technicalities whenever needed

•    Analyse, review and approve non regular jobs

•    Troubleshoot and analyze jobs and potential failures

The candidate

The ideal candidate has the following profile:

•    Strong troubleshooter and a systematic planner that is highly motivated by ensuring high quality and correctness in every detail

•    Excellent technical knowledge within Well Completions Services and tools and strong analytical capabilities

•    Robust stakeholder management skills and knows how to manage clients with diverse requirements and needs

•    Capable of working independently in a fast paced environment where adaptability is a key competence

•    Curious to learn about our tools and services and motivated to become an expert that teaches others

•    Has undergone thorough training and/or acquired broad experience with Well Completions Design, Well Completions Tools, Torque and Drag and Well Barriers

We expect you to have good English language skills and you are willing to travel from time to time. It is preferred if you have been working as a Completions Field Engineer or Service Delivery Manager and has a degree within Petroleum Engineering, Petroleum Technology or alike – but it is not required.

**Job Description

**_Business Analyst, Repair Services

_Curiosity in growing a business…

…customer minded…

…analytical & professional approach…

…collaborative spirit!

If this sounds like you, we’d love for you to join our international team which is based in Hamburg, Copenhagen and Singapore as the new Product Manager for Repair Services. Our business has been on a stable growth path in line with the market recovery - come along on our journey to continue this successful path and shape the future of Satair Repair Services!

**The Team's Mission

**Our mission is to ensure the commercial success of our product line, “Satair Repair Services” by driving its profitable growth. We hold the full ownership of our services - covering the repair, lease, and exchange of high-value structural aircraft parts (like flight controls) as well as avionics, and mechanical components from leading OEMs, and are in charge of the strategic and tactical steering of the product line.

**Your Role

**Based out of Copenhagen, you will play a central role in enhancing the overall business performance of the Repair Services product line. You will be involved in every stage of the product life cycle: from identifying new business opportunities and guiding partners through collaboration with Satair, to developing effective go-to-market strategies and tracking financial/operational performance. Working closely with cross-functional teams is essential to your success, as is monitoring the End to End (E2E) flow of business value from customer request to delivery.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Commercial Growth: Define go-to-market commercial strategies aligned with product line strategy and business objectives. Lead continuous improvement initiatives that directly drive business growth, managing them from concept to completion.

• Portfolio Evolution: Support enhancement and evolution of our portfolio

• Re-design Business Models & Asset Management: Analyze, map, and simplify complex organizational processes, technical dependencies, and business frameworks into clear, streamlined operational paths.

• Rapid Tool & App Co-Development: Collaborate with AI assistants (e.g., Gemini) and low-code/no-code platforms to rapidly design, prototype, and deploy internal apps and tools that solve corporate needs with the focus being on the business outcome.

• Analytics & Performance Steering: Collect, streamline, and analyze critical financial, operational, and technical data. Actively monitor leading KPIs on business health and initiate corrective measures. Transform historical data into forward-looking trends to enable timely, informed decision-making.

• Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management: Actively bring together focal points from the wider Airbus & Satair organization (Repair, Finance, Procurement, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Planning, Supply Chain, etc.).

**Desired Skills & Experience

**To be successful in this role, you must thrive in complexity, possessing the analytical depth to manage multifaceted tasks without losing sight of the details.

**Education & Professional Background

**

• A Master’s degree combined with 3 years of professional experience in a multinational B2B corporate environment in sales, product/program management, or supply chain, or in a role within aviation.

• Data Storytelling: High proficiency in data analytics with the ability to translate raw numbers into a compelling narrative and well-designed executive summaries.

• Proficient use of SAP or other ERP systems is a strong plus.

• Comfortable participating in business reporting processes and establishing quantifiable deliverables.

**Interpersonal Skills & Mindset

**

• Change Agent: Brings fresh ideas, challenges the status quo, and suggests highly efficient, scalable workflows rather than settling for the status-quo

• Stakeholder Management: A skilled communicator with excellent presentation and interpersonal skills, capable of aligning diverse cross-functional global stakeholders.

• Resilience & Decision-Making: Strong business acumen, maturity, and self-confidence. Ability to juggle multiple topics simultaneously and make firm, data-driven decisions.

• A diplomatic and strategic mindset.

**What does your next challenge look like?

**At SATAIR, we believe in sustainable aviation that allows people to travel and connect across the globe.

We are on a mission to provide world class material solutions that keep aircraft flying and extend their lifespan.

In Satair, you can challenge the status quo, pioneer new ways of working, and generate real value for airlines and suppliers worldwide.

Being part of the Airbus family gives us the opportunity to live a global mindset, working in international and diverse teams and collaborating across functions, sites and cultures.

If you want to work as one team embracing a can-do attitude in a demanding environment, then we offer a great place to explore, learn, and grow, making an impact on aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

_Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company!

_**About SATAIR

**Satair is an Airbus Services company offering first-class material management solutions in the aviation aftermarket industry. We take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience around the clock, driving innovation, and contributing to aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

With our global functional organisation spanning 12 sites and locations worldwide, and a team of over 2,000 people supporting a $3.9 billion turnover, you will be part of a truly global company that continues to grow year after year.

Welcome to the Satair family!

If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our website www.SATAIR.com or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel at www.youtube.com/sataircompany !

**What do we offer at SATAIR?

**At SATAIR, you will find much more than a job - we offer you the possibility of growing both your personal and professional capacities in a fun, supportive and informal working environment, where you will be encouraged to engage, share knowledge and ideas.

SATAIR is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We love to bring in people with different backgrounds and experiences as we believe it enhances our performance immensely!

Here is a selection of some of the benefits we offer our employees in Copenhagen:

Financial Benefits: Competitive salary, Employee Stock Ownership Program, Success sharing, Health insurance, Group accident insurance, Employee discounts to local businesses

Employee Health and Wellbeing: On-site gym, App-based health & wellbeing platform, Amazing canteen at a subsided price, Massage scheme

Learning and Development: Airbus Leadership University, Large number of e-learning and training offers for personal and professional development, Promotion of professional development (e.g. postgraduate studies, technician training), Possibility of mentoring, Gain international experience

Work-life blend and life phase support: Possibility to work remotely, 4 care days, Senior days, Working from home policy (2 days remote per week)

**Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company

We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

Are you passionate about shaping a more sustainable future and would you like to play a key role in Vattenfall’s transition to cleaner energy? Do you want to help drive the development, construction, and operation of our offshore wind portfolio? Vattenfall is looking for a Senior Consent Manager to strengthen its Offshore Consenting team in Denmark.

The Offshore Consenting team is an international team with representation in all Vattenfall’s key markets. We are involved throughout the offshore wind value chain, from pre-tender, through the tendering phase, project delivery, and throughout the operational phase. We are responsible for securing permits for Vattenfall’s offshore wind portfolio, and for enabling permit compliance during project delivery and operations.

In Denmark, Vattenfall and its partners are operating 5 offshore wind farms, including the Vesterhav Nord and Syd projects that were fully commissioned in 2024. Beyond our current portfolio, we have been awarded the two new Danish projects Hesselø and North Sea Central both including an onshore and offshore scope.

What will you do?

As Senior Consent Manager, you will play a pivotal role in enabling our offshore wind projects in Denmark. You will act as a coordinator and problem solver within the organization, working together with different teams and disciplines. In addition, you will be a key contact person externally towards authorities. For this position we are looking for a candidate with a strong profile within onshore permitting and environmental conditions, e.g., experience from onshore grid infrastructure projects in Denmark.

Consenting Strategy

• Analyse Consenting requirements, risks, and opportunities to support project execution

• Deliver and implement a Consenting Strategy in development and construction of the projects in collaboration with the offshore scope.

Obtain Consent

• Understand, anticipate and communicate which permits, laws and regulations are applicable to our projects;

• Ensure timely application for and receipt of permits, licenses and dispensations

Enable Consent Compliance

• Actively track and manage our permit requirements and commitments;

• Work with project teams and packages to enable full permit compliance of their respective scopes;

• Engage with and report to both local and state authorities.

Steer Consent

• Monitor and anticipate regulatory developments with a potential impact on our permits.

• Contribute to regulatory developments directly through consultations, or via our industry associations or interest groups.

Location

Copenhagen or Kolding.

Qualifications

You have an analytical mindset coupled with strong project management, communication- and interpersonal skills. You can structure and process complex information and discern implications for our business and can communicate clearly with various stakeholders and secure quality and timelines in projects.

You have experience working in international and multidisciplinary teams and thrive in a dynamic environment, skillfully managing multiple tasks under tight deadlines. Your excellent interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills allow you to build and maintain positive relationships across diverse teams. You can work well independently and in collaboration with others and have the dedication to see a task through despite challenges. Above all, you consistently prioritize health and safety in all aspects of your work.

You can have fun whilst being serious and are serious about having fun.

Next to this you bring:

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in the fields of biology, environmental science, spatial planning, or another relevant field;

• Knowledge of onshore environmental and spatial planning regulations;

• Ideally you have +5 years of relevant experience. Alternatively, you have gained (permit management) experience in other renewable energy, or other large infrastructure-, industrial-, or construction projects;

• Excellent oral and written communication skills in Danish (native or near native) and English (full working proficiency).

Additional Information

Our offer

Good remuneration, a challenging and international work environment, and the possibility to work with some of the best in the field. You will be working in interdisciplinary teams and you can always count on support from committed colleagues. We offer attractive employment conditions and opportunities for personal and professional development.

**The role and impact

**As the Head of Public Affairs, Denmark, you will be the primary architect of our political strategy, regulatory advocacy, and reputational standing in Denmark. Operating in a highly visible role, you will bridge the gap between our global business goals and the unique Danish political and societal landscape.

You will serve as the trusted face of the company to Danish government officials, regulators, trade associations, and civic leaders, while acting as a strategic advisor to our European executive leadership team.

Your success in this role ensures that our business not only navigates complex regulatory frameworks but actively shapes the policies that define our industry's future in Denmark.

**What you’ll bring

**Professional background: 15+ years of dedicated experience in government affairs, regulatory policy, public policy advocacy, or corporate-government relations in Denmark.

Educational foundation: A Bachelor’s degree in Public Policy, Law, Political Science, International Relations, or a strictly related field.

Strategic Advocacy & Lobbying: Develop and execute comprehensive public affairs campaigns to shape Danish policy in alignment with corporate objectives.

Political & Regulatory Intelligence: Actively monitor, analyze, and anticipate legislative developments in government ministries and relevant Danish agencies, translating complex political trends into actionable business intelligence for global leadership.

Stakeholder & Coalition Building: Build, maintain, and leverage a robust network of relationships with Danish policymakers, regulators, NGOs, think tanks, and industry trade associations (e.g., Dansk Industri). Lead management of framework agreement with the Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs supporting engagement in regions across the world where Topsoe does not have a PA presence and collaborating closely with the regional PA teams, eg Brussels, etc. where we do.

Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with internal business units and communication teams to ensure Danish public affairs strategies support global corporate initiatives and commercial goals.

**Why join us

**At Topsoe, we’re problem solvers. In every role, across every office, you’ll find people passionate about finding the right answers. For over 80 years, we’ve been pushing the boundaries of what’s possible, always focused on solving some of the world’s biggest challenges together. We believe great results start with collaboration and respect, where every idea is heard and can drive real change. You’ll join a team of dedicated experts, united by a commitment to perfecting our craft and delivering real impact. We don’t just promise change – we make it happen. And with your contributions, we’re shaping a more sustainable future with solutions that truly matter.

We prioritize the safety and well-being of our employees and are committed to maintaining a safe work environment where everyone looks out for each other's health and safety.

**Your new team

**The Head of PA, DK will report to the Head of Global Public Affairs and work closely with the broader Global Public Affairs team, with colleagues in Copenhagen, Brussels, the Middle East and Washington, DC.

Aalborg University is seeking an outstanding Professor in Mathematical Finance and Statistics to lead the newly established Research Center for Energy Mathematics, a strategic collaboration with Centrica Energy.

As the Centrica Energy Chair, you will work at the interface of academic research and challenges in energy markets, quantitative analytics, data science, and algorithmic decision-making.

Your work tasks

This is primarily a research and research-leadership position. You will conduct international leading research in energy mathematics, develop a long-term research agenda, publish in top-journals, attract external funding, and strengthen Aalborg University's position in the field.

As Director of the Research Center for Energy Mathematics, you will build and lead a research community of PhD students, postdoctoral researchers, visiting scholars and international collaborators. Collaboration with Centrica Energy will provide opportunities to engage in real-world challenges while preserving academic freedom and the highest scientific standards. You will supervise PhD students, postdoctoral researchers and master’s students. Teaching and administrative responsibilities are expected to be limited and organized to support the position’s focus on research and research leadership.

The aim is to establish a globally recognized center that advances fundamental and applied research in energy mathematics and contributes to academia, society, and the green energy transition

**Who we are looking for

**

We seek a researcher with a strong academic track record and the ambition to shape the emerging field of energy mathematics. Relevant expertise may include stochastic optimization, stochastic analysis, uncertainty quantification, mathematical modelling, machine learning, causal inference, computational mathematics, or related disciplines.

We welcome candidates with mathematical depth and broad intellectual curiosity, especially researchers who address fundamental questions about complex and uncertain energy systems and markets across traditional disciplinary boundaries. Applicants must demonstrate research experience at the highest international level through an outstanding publication record, doctoral supervision, competitive research funding and international collaboration.

In addition to scientific excellence, we are looking for a colleague who is enthusiastic about building and leading a collaborative research environment and with an openness to dialogue with industry.

Qualification requirements

Applicants must be able to document a high degree of original academic production at an international level and experience from teaching at different levels. Including tests/exams, course/study programme management as well as contributions to the development of teaching activities and teaching material.

Emphasis is placed on the extent, to which the applicant, has developed the academic discipline from a research and teaching perspective.

Emphasis may moreover be placed on the applicant’s ability to carry out and develop research-based public-sector consultancy. Also, emphasis will be placed on an assessment of the applicant’s ability to perform research and teaching management tasks and possibly fulfil other functions, for example in relation to the university’s external cooperation.

Emphasis will also be placed on the applicant's ability to undertake pedagogical supervision, supervision and academic assessment work.

Additional q ualification requirements

Applicants must hold a Ph.D. in mathematics or in a closely related discipline and have a sustained record of original and influential research.

Emphasis will be placed on the ability to formulate and pursue ambitious research agendas and to establish and lead an internationally recognized research environment. Experience with competitive research funding, international collaboration, and mentoring doctoral and postdoctoral researchers is important.

Applicants must preferably document university teaching and supervision experience at the undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral level.

Leadership experience with research teams, centers, or large collaborative projects is a strong plus. The ability to foster interdisciplinary collaboration and engage with partners in academia, industry, and the public sector is also valued.

The assessment will consider scientific achievements, academic leadership, educational contributions, supervision experience, international standing, and the potential to strengthen Aalborg University's research and education in energy mathematics.

Who we are

The position is anchored at the Department of Mathematical Sciences at Aalborg University, one of Scandinavia's leading environments for applied mathematics, stochastic modelling, and data-driven research. The department offers an international and collaborative research environment with strong links to academia, industry, and society.

The Research Center for Energy Mathematics is established through a strategic collaboration between Aalborg University and Centrica Energy, a leading European energy trading and energy management company active in power, gas, renewable energy, algorithmic trading, analytics, and quantitative research. While the professorship is an independent academic position at Aalborg University, the collaboration with Centrica Energy provides exceptional opportunities for research inspiration, access to relevant data and problems, and interaction with leading practitioners in quantitative energy trading and analytics.

Together, Aalborg University and Centrica Energy aim to create a globally recognized center in energy mathematics that attracts outstanding researchers and students from around the world.

• Additional qualifications in relation to the position

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. The successful applicant is expected, with support from the university, to acquire Danish language skills over time and to be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 2–5 years of employment, including grading and supervising students, at a level corresponding to the teaching undertaken.

You’ll work mainly on the backend, with a say in what we build and responsibility for taking it from an early idea to something customers use every day. That includes asking whether we’re solving the right problem, deciding what’s worth shipping first, and knowing when something needs more time.

**About Pandektes

**Our mission is to rebuild legal research from the ground up. Lawyers still lose countless hours to fragmented sources, outdated systems, and databases that fight them at every turn. We're building the largest AI-powered legal database in the world to make that friction disappear.

We're a team of 40+ based in our Copenhagen HQ, Zurich, London, and Hamburg. We’re a small team with high trust and flat structure. We move fast, argue our positions, and ship. If your input is good, it gets implemented - often within hours, not sprints.

We have has raised more than €4M, including a €2.9M seed round (Feb 2025) led by People Ventures, Interface Capital, and a strong bench of angels. We already serve 400+ customers across Denmark, Germany, and Switzerland, and we're just getting started.

**What We Value

**“How fast can we ship this?” comes up a lot at Pandektes. So does “we should take our time with this one.”

Knowing which question to ask is a big part of being an engineer here.

**Knowing when it’s good enough

**We like getting things into customers’ hands quickly. That means making trade-offs, questioning scope, and accepting when something is good enough for now. There’s usually another approach to explore or another prompt to try. At some point, you have to ship.

We use AI throughout our development process. AI code reviews, feature flags, and remote coding agents running end-to-end tests help us move quickly with confidence. Deciding what to build, what to check, and when it’s ready still takes judgment.

We value people who can find a smaller version worth shipping, explain the trade-offs, and follow through once customers start using it.

**Knowing when to slow down

**Some decisions deserve more time. Getting them right makes everything that follows easier. Getting them wrong means paying for the same mistake repeatedly.

Our default is to move quickly, so slowing down takes discipline. Sometimes it means pushing back when the rest of us want to get something out. We value someone who can explain why the extra work matters, challenge an approach, and help us decide where to spend our time.

You’ll have room to make those calls here, and teammates who will question them. We expect you to do the same for us.

**Make time to experiment

**We enjoy trying things before we know whether they’ll work. A new tool, a different way to use an agent, an idea that might turn out to be useless. Finding out is part of the work.

Once a month, we get together to demo our setups, show what we’re experimenting with, and share what we’ve learned. Sometimes we invite people from outside the team to show us how they work. Those sessions have changed how we build software.

We value curiosity and the generosity to bring other people along. If you find something useful, show us. If an experiment fails, we’d like to hear about that too.

We try to watch this video once a month to keep this value top of mind.

**The Experience You’ll Bring

**You’ve built and operated backend systems that real customers depend on. You can work through questions about data, APIs, performance, and security, and explain the consequences of your decisions.

Our stack includes TypeScript, NestJS, GraphQL, Postgres, and Prisma. We also work with OpenAI and Turbopuffer. Experience with these tools is useful; we’re especially interested in what you’ve built with them and the decisions you made along the way.

You enjoy working through a product problem while it’s still taking shape. You ask questions, share unfinished work, and help decide what’s worth building. You’re comfortable taking a feature from those early conversations through implementation, testing, and delivery.

**What we offer

**You’ll join at a point where there’s still a lot to shape. We offer competitive pay and equity so you can share in the success you help create.

We are usually office based but we all work from home time to time. You’ll have your own Pleo card for the tools and work expenses you need, plus 25 vacation days a year, public holidays, and paid parental leave when your family grows.

We also make time to get together away from our usual work. Our last team trip was to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you along for the next one.

At Stibo DX, we are looking for an experienced Director of Platform Engineering to lead a strategically important engineering domain and drive our transition toward SaaS.

Your primary mission is to accelerate the SaaS transformation. You will help shape a model in which Platform Engineering provides the shared foundation and developer enablement, while application teams remain accountable for the behavior, reliability, and operational outcomes of the services they build.

You will also lead the organization through this transition. Stibo DX is building toward a SaaS-first future while continuing to support self-hosted and hybrid customers. The role therefore requires someone who can balance the target state with pragmatic migration paths, preserving customer value while steadily reducing complexity and fragmentation.

Reporting directly to the CTO and serving both as a member of the Development Leadership Team and the company-wide Senior Leadership Team, you will lead a domain of 14 people and contribute to the continued development of both your domain and the wider engineering organization. The role can be based at any of our Stibo DX offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Hamburg, Oslo, or Málaga.

Key responsibilities

You will lead and develop a distributed engineering organization while creating the structure, capabilities, and momentum required to scale Stibo DX’s SaaS transformation. Your responsibilities will include:

• Lead and develop the distributed Cloud Platform, Print Platform, and Content Delivery teams.

• Build a coherent platform-engineering organization with a shared mission, clear ownership, and strong execution.

• Accelerate the SaaS transformation by translating strategic direction into platform capabilities, adoption paths, and measurable outcomes.

• Experience with customer-facing SaaS products and the organizational changes required to support SaaS-first delivery models.
